statements.statement: The procedure code billed was CPT 93247
The patient presented with intermittent palpitations and episodes of dizziness
These symptoms persisted despite initial evaluation
There was concern for an underlying arrhythmia
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring was indicated to capture elusive symptoms and correlate them with cardiac rhythm disturbances
The required prior authorization was missing
The claim was denied on medical necessity grounds
The denial reason code was CO-197
The diagnosis codes were R00.2 and R42
